topic: Allostatic load: chronic stress's physiological cost
caption: Did you know your body has a 'stress meter'? 📊 Allostatic load measures the toll of chronic stress on your physiology. High allostatic load is linked to anxiety, digestive issues, and even heart disease. 🤕 Save this to understand how stress affects you. Share with someone who's struggling with stress.
